context: Add a third backend kind to the Anthropic-surface routing authority: a catalog-owning backend whose prefix is authoritative for its declared catalog and which receives bare routing only for ids unique to it.
root_causes: ADR 0008 defines only rowless backends (prefix authoritative for any bare id) and rows-owning backends (bare id must be indexed to itself), so a backend with a discoverable catalog that overlaps other backends cannot be expressed.
Seeding such a catalog into _MODEL_INDEX to gain bare routing makes the backend rows-owning by derivation, at which point a qualified id naming a model an incumbent owns resolves to None.
Not seeding it leaves the backend rowless, which grants qualified routing for anything but forbids bare routing entirely.
evidence: _resolve_qualified returns the provider unconditionally when the provider is absent from _BACKENDS_WITH_ROWS, and otherwise requires _MODEL_INDEX[bare] == provider.
_BACKENDS_WITH_ROWS is frozenset(_MODEL_INDEX.values()), so index membership alone decides which branch a backend takes.
The OpenCode Go catalog probed on 2026-08-11 contains kimi-k3, deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-v4-flash, which are indexed to kimi and deepseek.
solutions: Declare catalog-owning backends explicitly with their catalog of bare ids, rather than inferring a kind from index membership.
Resolve the catalog-owning branch before the rowless and rows-owning branches so the declared catalog is authoritative behind the prefix and fails closed outside it.
Seed only the ids no incumbent already claims, so incumbency wins and G1's conflict guard is not tripped by a deliberate deference.
acceptance_criteria: A qualified id in the declared catalog resolves to the catalog-owning backend even when the bare id is indexed to an incumbent.
A qualified id outside the declared catalog fails closed, so the prefix is never a fail-open bypass.
A bare id unique to the catalog-owning backend resolves to it.
A bare id an incumbent claims still resolves to the incumbent.
claude remains fail-closed on every path.
Existing rowless and rows-owning resolution is unchanged.
legacy_risk_reason: changes the single resolution authority shared by claude, codex, deepseek, kimi, copilot and auggie; a regression silently reroutes a model to a different upstream subscription
